lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: Yeah... that's going to leave a mark though.  Where's Rowland?

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: Rowland?  I haven't seen him around.  What have you two been doing, throwing clubs at each other?

lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: No, we were just out training, and then we got ambushed by bandits!  I thought we had fought them all off, but one must have snuck up on us as we were on our way out.

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: Ugh, why is it always bandits?

lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: I know, right?  You'd think we have a more original plot or something.

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: These seem like their tracks.  We should go get the town watch to come track them down.  That's their job, after all.

lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: Get help?  No way!  We don't have time to waste.  Rowland is in danger!

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: Which means I get to come make sure you don't get yourself killed.  Well, it's a good thing I didn't have plans today or anything.

lines.speaker: adelard
lines.text: Yup, good thing!  Let's go, sis!
As they're on the bandits trail, they realize they are being followed and have to escape into the woods.
